title.en: I Died 999,999 Times: Unlimited Level-Up with My Immortality Skill

altTitles.ja: 999999回死んだ俺　～不死身スキルで無限レベルアップ～

altTitles.en: I Died 999999 Times – Infinite Level Up with Invulnerability Skills

description.en:
White Lotus, the world’s strongest hunter guild, is praised as a group of heroes for defeating the Demon Lords.  

But their power comes from something far darker—ruthless and inhumane cruelty. They captured Makoto and Minori, a pair of immortal siblings, and slaughtered them repeatedly to farm experience points.  

Desperate to survive and fueled by vengeance, the siblings make a brutal choice: killing each other to level up.

"Let’s begin our revenge." 

Through relentless battles and newfound powers, they carve a path of blood and retribution.
